passages.text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
Jesus finished saying these things.
He left Galilee.
He went into the region of Judea.
This region was beyond the Jordan River.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους μετῆρεν ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου

passages.text: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
passages.sermon:
Jesus left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
Many people followed Jesus.
Large crowds came after Him.
Jesus healed the people there.
passages.original: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ

passages.text: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
passages.sermon:
Some Pharisees came to Jesus.
The Pharisees wanted to test Jesus.
They asked Jesus a question.
They said, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
passages.original: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ Φαρισαῖοι πειράζοντες αὐτὸν καὶ λέγοντες Εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνθρώπῳ ἀπολῦσαι τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἰτίαν

passages.text: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’ and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the Pharisees.
Jesus answered their question.
Jesus referred to the Scriptures.
Jesus said, “Have you not read this?”
God is the Creator.
God made people from the beginning.
God made them male and female.
God said something important about marriage.
God said, “A man will leave his father and mother.”
A man will join with his wife.
The man and his wife will become one flesh.
The two people become one.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ὁ κτίσας ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς Ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν Ἕνεκα τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ κολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν

passages.text: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the Pharisees.
He explained God’s design for marriage.
God joins a husband and wife together.
They become one flesh.
They are no longer two people.
They are now united as one.
God has joined them together.
No person should separate what God has joined.
passages.original: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία ὃ οὖν ὁ Θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω

passages.text: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”
passages.sermon:
Some people spoke to Jesus.
They asked Jesus a question.
They said, “Why did Moses command this?”
They said, “Why did Moses tell a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce?”
They said, “Why did Moses tell a man to send his wife away?”
passages.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο δοῦναι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν

passages.text: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart; but it was not this way from the beginning.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to them.
He answered their question.
He said that Moses allowed them to divorce their wives.
He explained the reason.
He said their hearts were hard.
He said this permission was because of their hardness of heart.
He said it was not like this at the beginning.
He said God did not intend divorce from the start.
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὅτι Μωϋσῆς πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἐπέτρεψεν ὑμῖν ἀπολῦσαι τὰς γυναῖκας ὑμῶν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς δὲ οὐ γέγονεν οὕτως

passages.text: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people.
Jesus gave a clear teaching about divorce and remarriage.
Jesus said, “If a man divorces his wife, he must have a reason of sexual immorality.
If he divorces her for any other reason, and marries another woman, he commits adultery.”
passages.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐπὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην μοιχᾶται

passages.text: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus taught about marriage and divorce.
His disciples listened to Him.
The disciples spoke to Jesus.
They said, “If this is the situation between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
passages.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί αὐτοῦ Εἰ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ αἰτία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός οὐ συμφέρει γαμῆσαι

passages.text: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to His disciples.\r\nJesus said, “Not everyone can accept this teaching.\r\nOnly those to whom it has been given can accept it.”
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ πάντες χωροῦσιν τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἀλλ’ οἷς δέδοται

passages.text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He explained about people who do not marry.
Some people are eunuchs from birth.
They were born that way.
Some people are made eunuchs by other people.
Others choose to live like eunuchs.
They do this for the sake of the kingdom of heaven.
Anyone who can accept this should accept it.
passages.original: εἰσὶν γὰρ εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἐγεννήθησαν οὕτως καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν ὁ δυνάμενος χωρεῖν χωρείτω

passages.text: Then the little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
passages.sermon:
People brought little children to Jesus.
They wanted Jesus to place His hands on the children.
They wanted Jesus to pray for the children.
The disciples saw this.
The disciples rebuked the people who brought the children.
passages.original: Τότε προσηνέχθησαν αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιθῇ αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεύξηται οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς

passages.text: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke.
He said, “Let the little children come to Me.
Do not stop them.
The kingdom of heaven belongs to people like these children.”
passages.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτὰ ἐλθεῖν πρός με τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν

passages.text: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there.
passages.sermon: Jesus placed His hands on the children.\r\nThen Jesus left that place.
passages.original: καὶ ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν

passages.text: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
passages.sermon:
A man approached Jesus.
The man spoke to Jesus.
The man called Jesus “Teacher.”
The man asked a question.
He said, “What good thing must I do?”
He wanted to know how to obtain eternal life.
passages.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ εἶπεν Διδάσκαλε τί ἀγαθὸν ποιήσω ἵνα σχῶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον

passages.text: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus replied to the man.
Jesus said, "Why do you ask Me about what is good?"
Only One is good.
If you want to enter life, keep the commandments."
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τί με ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός εἰ δὲ θέλεις εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν τήρησον τὰς ἐντολάς

passages.text: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “ ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”
passages.sermon:
A man spoke to Jesus.
He asked Jesus, “Which commandments should I keep?”
Jesus answered the man.
Jesus said, “Do not murder.”
Jesus said, “Do not commit adultery.”
Jesus said, “Do not steal.”
Jesus said, “Do not bear false witness.”
Jesus said, “Honor your father and your mother.”
Jesus said, “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίας Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τὸ Οὐ φονεύσεις Οὐ μοιχεύσεις Οὐ κλέψεις Οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν

passages.text: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
passages.sermon: A young man spoke to Jesus.\r\nHe said, “I have kept all these commandments.”\r\nHe asked, “What do I still lack?”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ

passages.text: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the young man.
Jesus said, "If you want to be perfect, do this.
Go and sell your possessions.
Give the money to the poor.
You will have treasure in heaven.
Then come.
Follow Me."
passages.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι

passages.text: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
passages.sermon:
A young man spoke with Jesus.
The young man owned much wealth.
Jesus told him to sell his possessions and give to the poor.
The young man heard these words.
He became sad.
He went away in sorrow.
He felt sorrow because he had many possessions.
passages.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά

passages.text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to His disciples.\r\nJesus said, “I tell you the truth.\r\nIt is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.”
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πλούσιος δυσκόλως εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν

passages.text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, “I tell you again.
A camel is a large animal.
A needle has a very small hole called the eye.
It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle.
It is harder for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
passages.original: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρυπήματος ῥαφίδος εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
passages.sermon:
The disciples heard what Jesus said.
The disciples felt very surprised.
The disciples asked a question.
They said, “Who then can be saved?”
passages.original: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες Τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι

passages.text: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus looked at His disciples.
Jesus spoke to them.
Jesus said, “This is impossible for people.
But everything is possible for God.”
passages.original: Ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν παρὰ δὲ Θεῷ πάντα δυνατά

passages.text: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
passages.sermon:
Peter was a disciple of Jesus.
Peter spoke to Jesus.
Peter said, “Look, we have left everything.
We have followed You.
What will there be for us?”
passages.original: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν

passages.text: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, “I tell you the truth.
You have followed Me.
One day, God will renew all things.
At that time, the Son of Man will sit on His glorious throne.
You who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones.
You will judge the twelve tribes of Israel.”
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι ἐν τῇ παλινγενεσίᾳ ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ καθήσεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ

passages.text: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He described a reward for those who follow Him.
Anyone who leaves something important for Jesus will receive a reward.
Some people leave their houses for Jesus.
Some people leave their brothers or sisters for Jesus.
Some people leave their father or mother for Jesus.
Some people leave their wife or children for Jesus.
Some people leave their fields for Jesus.
They do this for the sake of Jesus’ name.
God will give them a hundred times more than what they left.
They will also inherit eternal life.
passages.original: καὶ πᾶς ὅστις ἀφῆκεν οἰκίας ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ μου ὀνόματός ἑκατονταπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει

passages.text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to His disciples.\r\nJesus said, “Many people who are first now will be last later.\r\nMany people who are last now will be first later.”
passages.original: Πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι
